anchors.name: New or modified transaction validity mechanisms
anchors.notes: Initcode limit increases from 48KB to 128KB. Existing valid initcode remains valid.

anchors.name: Performance risks
anchors.notes: 64KB contracts = 2.67x more bytecode to load, increased JUMPDEST analysis time, larger Merkle proofs. Code loading can be benchmarked in isolation but real-world impact depends on block composition.

anchors.name: Security risks
anchors.notes: EIP-170's 24KB limit was a DoS mitigation - now relaxed. The 2 gas/word pricing must accurately reflect resource costs; if wrong, enables cheaper DoS than expected. May require validation of gas pricing against actual resource consumption.

anchors.name: Cross-EIP interactions
